title: The Sign Code: The Hidden Binary Nature of Deep Networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.23616v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Every neuron in a trained network outputs a number that can be separated into its sign (positive or negative) and its magnitude (absolute size). We call the set of all neuron signs the \textit{sign code}. This raises a key question: does classification depend more on the sign code or on the magnitudes? For overparameterized vision classifiers with sign-preserving activations, the answer is overwhelmingly the sign code. A $k$-nearest neighbor classifier operating only on this binary sign code achieves accuracy comparable to the full model across different architectures, activation functions, and datasets. Moreover, replacing all magnitudes in every layer with random noise while keeping the original signs barely changes residual network performance. In contrast, flipping just 20\% of the signs reduces accuracy to chance. Models generalize well when same-class inputs share similar sign codes. When this overlap is disrupted by a regularizer,

translated_title: 符号编码：深度网络的隐藏二值本质
translated_abstract: 在训练好的网络中，每个神经元输出的数值都可以分解为符号（正或负）和幅值（绝对大小）。我们将所有神经元符号的集合称为“符号编码”。由此引出一个关键问题：分类更多依赖于符号编码还是幅值？对于采用符号保持激活函数的过参数化视觉分类器，答案压倒性地是符号编码。仅基于这一二值符号编码运行的k近邻分类器，在不同的架构、激活函数和数据集上都能取得与完整模型相当的准确率。此外，在保留原始符号的同时，将每一层的所有幅值替换为随机噪声，几乎不会改变残差网络的性能。相反，仅仅翻转20%的符号就会使准确率降至随机水平。当同类输入共享相似的符号编码时，模型具有良好的泛化能力。而当这种重叠被正则化器破坏时，……
tldr: 该论文发现深度网络的分类能力几乎完全由神经元激活的符号（二值符号编码）而非幅值决定——仅凭符号编码即可达到与完整模型相当的准确率，而翻转20%的符号就会使性能降至随机水平。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that deep network classification depends overwhelmingly on the binary sign code of neuron activations rather than their magnitudes—a k-NN classifier using signs alone matches full model accuracy, while flipping just 20% of signs reduces accuracy to chance.
